package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// scenario for bootstrap_builds_clients_inside_route_registration: Startup code that hides dependency construction inside route registration functions.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func RegisterRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("db connection failed: %v\n", err)
		return
	}

	redisClient := newRedisClient(os.Getenv("REDIS_URL"))

	httpClient := &http.Client{}

	mux.HandleFunc("/api/users", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		rows, err := db.QueryContext(r.Context(), "SELECT id, name FROM users")
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "db error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		defer rows.Close()
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "users listed")
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("/api/cache", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		redisClient.Get(r.Context(), "some-key")
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "cache hit")
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("/api/proxy", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		httpClient.Get("https://upstream.example.com/data")
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "proxy done")
	})
}

func newRedisClient(addr string) *fakeRedisClient { return &fakeRedisClient{} }

type fakeRedisClient struct{}
func (f *fakeRedisClient) Get(ctx interface{}, key string) (string, error) { return "", nil }
